Frequently Asked Questions (Shopify vs Etsy)

At how many monthly orders does Shopify become cheaper than Etsy?

For an average $40 order, Shopify Basic ($39/month) breaks even against organic Etsy fees at roughly 14 orders per month (~$560/month in sales). Every order beyond that saves ~6.6% in platform fees.

Should I close my Etsy shop when launching Shopify?

No! Smart sellers keep Etsy as a discovery funnel for new customers while directing repeat buyers (via package inserts and email lists) to their Shopify store where margins are 7%–20% higher.
